term.name: schema_location_hint
term.definition: A URI reference an instance gives for a schema document (XSD 1.1 Part 1, 4.3.2): the second of each pair of an xsi:schemaLocation attribute, for the namespace of the first, or a value of xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation, for no namespace; followed only when the host asks (sxml_schema_configuration.schema_location_hint_node), and then only for namespaces the schema does not have yet ()
